detail.longDescription: Counting a 30-day deadline in a US federal court? Rule 6(a) of the Federal Rules of Civil Procedure says skip the day of the triggering event, then count EVERY day, weekends and holidays included. Only if the last day lands on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday does it roll to the next regular day. So you can't just count business days. Always check the actual rule for your court. https:// workdays.wooooju.com # productivity # deadlines # legal
